 Hindustan Copper Q2 profit rises 47% to ₹520 cr, revenue up 25%
 SECTIONS Hindustan Copper Q2 profit rises 47% to ₹520 cr, revenue up 25% ET Online Last Updated: Nov 11, 2026, 09:28:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Hindustan Copper Limited achieved a consolidated net profit of ₹520 crore in the second quarter of FY27. The revenue for the quarter increased to ₹1,175 crore, marking a notable rise. EBITDA rose significantly to ₹703 crore, reflecting enhanced operating efficiency. The EBITDA margin improved to 59.9%, indicating greater profitability compared to the previous quarter. These figures highlight the company's positive financial performance and robust growth trajectory.
 Agencies Representative Image Hindustan Copper Limited reported a 47.3% quarter-on-quarter increase in consolidated net profit to ₹520 cr for the second quarter of FY27, compared to ₹353 cr in the previous quarter .
 Revenue rose 25.4% QoQ to ₹1,175 cr from ₹937 cr.
The company's EBITDA increased 38.4% to ₹703 cr from ₹508 cr in the previous quarter. 
EBITDA margin improved to 59.9% in Q2 FY27, from 54.2% in the preceding quarter, indicating an improvement in operating profitability.
